A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same SysCaps research work and complete Appendices A-C. All 23 pages were compared; body text, equations, tables, figures, and their placement match. Differences are confined to the publication header and arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v3 reports original surrogate-model experiments on building energy consumption and wind farm power generation, including accuracy, ablations, generalization tests, and qualitative predictions in Section 6 and the appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains those original empirical results, including the building and wind farm comparisons in Tables 1-5 and test predictions in Appendix C.

M1.justification: Sections 4-5 retain identical caption-generation procedures, text and sequence encoders, multimodal fusion, prediction architecture, and training objective.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Buildings-900K building data and Wind Farm Wake Modeling Dataset, with identical prediction tasks and caption-generalization scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: Table 1 retains LightGBM and one-hot SSM, LSTM, and ResNet baselines; Table 5 retains LightGBM and one-hot ResNet. The synonym-test controls also match.

E3.justification: Section 6 and Appendix A report identical splits, sample sizes, preprocessing, metrics, model configurations, hyperparameter searches, and evaluation procedures.

E4.justification: The same attribute and encoder ablations, caption-length and synonym tests, design-space sensitivity and failure analyses, prompt-augmentation comparison, and appendix case studies appear in both versions.

E5.justification: The three-random-seed reporting in Tables 1 and 5 and all reported uncertainty terms are identical. No run-count disclosures or statistical procedures are added or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings match, including Tables 1-5 and Appendix C predictions. For example, Table 5 reports SysCaps-nl NRMSE of 0.035 ± 0.001 in both versions.

T1.justification: The problem formulation in Section 3, training objective in Equation 1, and metric expressions and reasoning in Appendix A.1 are identical. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs change.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical contributions and claims about language interfaces, surrogate accuracy, caption generalization, and prompt augmentation.

C2.justification: Interpretations and limitations are unchanged, including caption-quality explanations, numerical interpolation and formatting failures, concerns about many attributes, and the absence of user studies.

D1.justification: Implementation details, prompts, preprocessing, hyperparameters, hardware, and training times remain identical. The code/data access statement and PDF link targets also match.

R1.justification: Section 2, the references, and statements positioning SysCaps against prior research are unchanged. The added publication header does not revise research positioning.

P1.justification: v4 adds 'Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2025' to each page and updates the arXiv stamp from v3 dated 11 March 2025 to v4 dated 18 April 2025. Body wording and section structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: The running publication header and first-page margin stamp change visually. All 13 figures, seven tables, captions, and body-content positions remain identical.

improvement.justification: v4 adds publication-status information and updates the version stamp, while retaining identical scientific content, evidence, explanations, reproducibility details, and appendices. These administrative presentation changes do not meaningfully alter the paper's overall quality.
